patch_description: Replace the exponentially-weighted moving average with a zero-phase Savitzky-Golay (local quadratic polynomial) smoother, which preserves signal dynamics much better than an average, followed by a noise-scaled trend gate to suppress spurious reversals. The SG filter is applied forward and backward (and via reflection-padded convolution) to cancel phase delay, minimizing lag error. Slopes below a robust MAD-based noise threshold are zeroed and the level rebuilt, reducing slope changes and false reversals while preserving genuine trends. All operations are vectorized convolutions for O(n) runtime.
